description: Move an object to another node of a workflow (or start it there). Checked against the workflow: a regular next step or an edge whose condition holds is fine; going BACK (reset) or jumping needs grund (who asked for it and why) and may be forbidden by the workflow; a failing condition is refused with the condition. Records the event and fires the target node's trigger (handoff to a person or task for an agent). For Pipedrive-sourced workflows the deal is moved in Pipedrive too (in_quelle=false to only record). nach = node schluessel or id. Optional daten: extra object data for conditions (objects without their own table).

daten.description: Extra object data for condition checks (objects without their own table)

in_quelle.description: false only records the move without moving the deal in Pipedrive

objekt_typ.description: Type of the object to move (e.g. deal, lead, project)

titel.description: Display title of the object in the workflow, if not known from its record

name: move_workflow
